title: Yellow Rich Polish Mushroom Pasta
description: A rich and comforting Polish dish featuring mushrooms, sherry vinegar, and a mother-sauce base, perfect for curing hangovers. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is a hearty and satisfying meal.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat and add the mixed mushrooms, cooking until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the sherry vinegar to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Sprinkle the flour over the mushrooms and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the vegetable broth to the skillet, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the grated cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the mushroom sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
